question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Words carved on a stone or monument
solution: The correct answer is **'Inscription'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Inscription**__**: W****ords that are written or cut on something** **(किसी वस्‍तु पर अंकित या उत्‍कीर्ण शब्‍द)** __ • **​E.g.__**- There was an Urdu **inscription** on the tombstone. Hence, the correct answer is **'Inscription'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Transcription**__**:** **Something that is represented in writing (लिखित रूप में प्रस्‍तुत कोई वस्‍तु****)** __ • **​E.g.__**-** **This dictionary gives phonetic **transcriptions** of all headwords. • __**Prescription**__**: A paper on which a doctor has written the name of the medicine (डॉक्‍टर का लिखा दवा का परचा****)** __ • **​E.g.__**- Some medicines are only available on **prescription**. • __**Subscription**__**: **​**An amount of money that you pay, usually once a year, to receive a newspaper or magazine** ** regularly or to belong to an organization (अख़बार या पत्रिका या किसी संस्‍था का वार्षिक सदस्‍यता-शुल्‍क)** __ • **E.g.**__- I decided to take out a **subscription** to a gardening magazine. 42:T1bf6, The correct answer is **"my".**
